thread:
oliver (AE): FYI — HeliosFin (enterprise banking) is asking for a binding Q4 commit. Traffic shape: 420 rps peak, ~22k tokens/session avg, heavy docs + chat. They want 99.9% uptime during 13:00-15:00 ET and p50 < 250ms. Need reserved GPU recommendation + burst credit proposal.

tara (Sales Eng): 420 rps at 22k tokens is heavy on KV and memory. Is that sustained for the whole 2hr window?

oliver (AE): Yes sustained 2 hours on trading days, plus unpredictable 30m surges outside that window.

li (Solutions): Two parts: (1) model footprint — can they accept int4/int8 quantized variants? (2) ops — prewarm schedule and cache persistence. If they accept quantization we can cut GPU count ~2.3x.

sam (SRE): Quick thumb calc: assume 0.1 tokens/ms per A100-equivalent GPU for long contexts after optimizations. 22k tokens/session -> ~220s per session? That seems off — need to split prompt vs generation. I'll run a microbench but suggest conservative sizing until then.

harper (Infra): Also confirm if they want Private VPC deploy. If Private, AZ spread and dedicated racks reduce burst into the shared pool. Lead time for infra changes ~3-4 weeks.

oliver (AE): They require Private (VPC) + HSM/KMS integration. Also legal flagged data residency for EU clients.

li (Solutions): Proposal: baseline 6 reserved GPUs (quantized) for steady 2hr window, + 2 burst GPUs with 60min warm window. Autoscale policy to cap burst to 2 concurrent GPUs and use a token-credit bucket for bursts. Use prefix/KV persistent cache with 24h TTL.

sam (SRE): Draft autoscale snippet for ops runbook:
```
autoscale:
  baseline_replicas: 6
  max_burst: 2
  burst_duration_sec: 3600  # 60min
  burst_credit_monthly: 200000  # tokens
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    persistence: true
    ttl_hours: 24
  prewarm_jobs:
    - cron: "0 12 * * 1-5"  # prewarm 1h before market
      replicas: 8
```
Note: prewarm must run against warmed KV store; initial warm is slow for very long contexts.

harper (Infra): KMS checklist: service account with decrypt-only for prewarm, network egress rules to KMS endpoints, HSM cert rotation window. I'll add this to handoff.

li (Solutions): Cost modeling ask from procurement: show baseline monthly + burst credits and a worst-case overage scenario (4x burst events/month). We'll show two columns: quantized vs fp16. Use 2.4x efficiency for quantized in estimates.

oliver (AE): They want an amortized per-token cost for CFO. Can we give an immediate conservative estimate?

tara (Sales Eng): Quick conservative numbers: if one A100 equiv costs X per hour, baseline 6 GPUs * hours/month -> A; quantized reduces compute to A/2.4. Add burst credits cost B for peak minutes. I'll put raw numbers in the price summary but need perf numbers to be accurate.

sam (SRE): I can run perf runs on their model tomorrow. Need their container + sample prompts. If they supply by EOD, I'll prioritize. Until then recommendation: reserve 6 quantized GPUs (baseline) + 2 burst, 200k monthly token credits, auto-degrade policy to smaller quantized-2 model if queue depth > 200 for 45s.

oliver (AE): Action items: (1) sam to run perf tests on provided model by 16:00 UTC tomorrow; (2) li to draft price table quantized vs fp16 and worst-case overage scenarios; (3) harper to enumerate Private infra lead times and KMS runbook; (4) tara to prepare CFO-friendly summary and legal handoff note about uptime window.

tara (Sales Eng): Also flag: if they insist on 99.95% SLA for market hours, we should recommend dedicated AZ spread and likely reserve + active-active failover which increases reserved count by ~1-2 GPUs. Call out in the proposal.

harper (Infra): Confirmed — AZ spread within customer's VPC doable, will impact burst capacity. I'll include timing and trade-offs.

sam (SRE): Operational suggestion: bake a canary flow that hits the smaller model first for 5% of traffic during ramp. Auto-fallback to cached responses for known prompts if LM generation latency spikes.

security-bot: Security checklist: outstanding items - KMS test, SOC2 attestation copy, vendor encryption report.

oliver (AE): I'll ping HeliosFin to send the perf container and confirm the Private deploy. Re-open once sam posts numbers. :handshake:

tara (Sales Eng): Thanks — will prep the procurement note and link ops runbook template.

li (Solutions): I'll include runbook excerpt and KMS steps in the handoff doc.

oliver (AE): Closing thread until perf runs complete.
